ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit 2.0/3.0 Group Policy propagation — SYSVOL ScheduledTasks/Scripts write from non-machine account
ucs.description: Hunts the signature LockBit 2.0/3.0 (LockBit Black) automated domain-wide deployment pattern: after compromising a Domain Admin, the affiliate writes ScheduledTasks.xml / Registry.xml / Services.xml / .bat / .ps1 / encryptor payload directly into the GPO SYSVOL\Policies path so every domain-joined host pulls and executes it on the next gpupdate. This is what made LockBit operationally distinct from earlier RaaS families and is documented in CISA AA23-075A.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*\\Policies\\*") AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("ScheduledTasks.xml","Registry.xml","Services.xml") OR Filesystem.file_name="*.bat" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ps1" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") AND NOT match(user,"(?i)^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FolderPath has @"\SYSVOL\" and FolderPath has @"\Policies\"
| where FileName =~ "ScheduledTasks.xml"
     or FileName =~ "Registry.xml"
     or FileName =~ "Services.xml"
     or FileName endswith ".bat"
     or FileName endswith ".ps1"
     or FileName endswith ".exe"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"      // exclude machine accounts — GPO replication runs as SYSTEM
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          ParentProc = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          FileName, FolderPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where TargetFilePath has @"\SYSVOL\" and TargetFilePath has @"\Policies\"
| where TargetFileName =~ "ScheduledTasks.xml"
     or TargetFileName =~ "Registry.xml"
     or TargetFileName =~ "Services.xml"
     or TargetFileName endswith ".bat"
     or TargetFileName endswith ".ps1"
     or TargetFileName endswith ".exe"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActorUsername !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          TargetFileName, TargetFilePath, TargetFileSHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit GPO Propagation via SYSVOL Policy Modification
id: 7f3a2b1c-8d49-4e22-a3b7-5e1c2f8d6a9b
status: experimental
description: Detects writes of GPO preference manifests, scripts or executables directly into a SYSVOL Policies path by a non-machine account. Matches LockBit 2.0/3.0 automated domain-wide deployment after Domain Admin compromise (CISA AA23-075A).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-075a
author: detection engineering
date: 2026/06/17
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains|all:
      - '\SYSVOL\'
      - '\Policies\'
  selection_file:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\ScheduledTasks.xml'
      - '\Registry.xml'
      - '\Services.xml'
      - '.bat'
      - '.ps1'
      - '.exe'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  filter_service_accounts:
    User:
      - 'SYSTEM'
      - 'LOCAL SERVICE'
      - 'NETWORK SERVICE'
  condition: selection_path and selection_file and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Authorised Group Policy edits performed interactively by domain administrators (baseline these accounts)
  - GPMC / AGPM tooling
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.lateral_movement
  - attack.t1570
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1484.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\* OR *\\Sysvol\\*)) (@TargetFilename:(*\\Policies\\* OR *\\policies\\*)) (@TargetFilename:(*\\ScheduledTasks.xml OR *\\scheduledtasks.xml OR *\\Registry.xml OR *\\registry.xml OR *\\Services.xml OR *\\services.xml OR *.bat OR *.BAT OR *.ps1 OR *.PS1 OR *.exe OR *.EXE)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| regex("\\\\SYSVOL\\\\.+\\\\Policies\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
| TargetFileName=/(ScheduledTasks\.xml|Registry\.xml|Services\.xml|\.bat|\.ps1|\.exe)$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=[count(as=Writes), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Random APTs do not push ransomware through GPO — they SMB-push, PsExec or Cobalt Strike beacon. LockBit 2.0 was the first major family to weaponise GPO replication for ransomware fan-out, and LockBit 3.0 (Black) kept the technique. The combination (non-machine account + SYSVOL\Policies path + ScheduledTasks/Registry/Services XML or script/binary) is a near-zero baseline outside genuine GPMC sessio

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit pre-encryption sabotage — chained vssadmin/wmic/bcdedit/wbadmin/wevtutil within a single host
ucs.description: Hunts LockBit's signature anti-recovery prelude: the loader (or a remote operator via PsExec/CS) fires vssadmin delete shadows, wmic shadowcopy delete, bcdedit recoveryenabled no / bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures, wbadmin delete catalog and wevtutil cl <log> back-to-back on the same host. Hunting 3+ of these specific binaries with the LockBit-characteristic flags inside a 10-minute window catches the loader before the file-rename pass starts.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as binaries values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*" AND Processes.process="*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="wevtutil.exe" AND Processes.process="*cl *")) by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval binary_count=mvcount(binaries) | where binary_count>=3 AND NOT match(user,"\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "catalog")
     or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName, 10),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            BinaryCount = dcount(FileName)
  by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where BinaryCount >= 3      // 3+ distinct anti-recovery tools in 10m == LockBit canonical chain
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinL = tolower(NewProcessName), CmdL = tolower(CommandLine)
| where (BinL endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CmdL has "delete" and CmdL has "shadows")
     or (BinL endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CmdL has "shadowcopy" and CmdL has "delete")
     or (BinL endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (CmdL has "recoveryenabled" or CmdL has "bootstatuspolicy"))
     or (BinL endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CmdL has "delete" and CmdL has "catalog")
     or (BinL endswith "\\wevtutil.exe" and CmdL has "cl ")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Binaries = make_set(NewProcessName, 10),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),
            BinaryCount = dcount(BinL)
  by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where BinaryCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*) AND @CommandLine:(*shadows* OR *Shadows* OR *SHADOWS*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\WMIC.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* OR *ShadowCopy* OR *SHADOWCOPY*) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\\bcdEdit.exe) AND (@CommandLine:(*recoveryenabled* OR *RecoveryEnabled* OR *recoveryEnabled*) OR @CommandLine:(*bootstatuspolicy* OR *BootStatusPolicy* OR *bootStatusPolicy*))) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE OR *\\wbAdmin.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete* OR *DELETE*) AND @CommandLine:(*catalog* OR *Catalog* OR *CATALOG*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE OR *\\WevtUtil.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*" cl "* OR *" CL "*))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (
    (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete/i AND CommandLine=/shadows/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy/i AND CommandLine=/delete/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete/i AND CommandLine=/catalog/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\s+cl\s+/i)
  )
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, bucket(span=10m)], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=BinaryCount), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])])
| BinaryCount >= 3
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Many ransomware families wipe shadow copies, but LockBit's loader is documented (CISA AA23-075A, Mandiant) as firing the FULL anti-recovery sequence — VSS + WMIC shadowcopy + bcdedit recovery/bootstatuspolicy + wbadmin catalog + wevtutil log clearing — within seconds, often inline from a single batch file dropped next to the encryptor. The 3-of-5 distinct-binary threshold inside 10 minutes filters
